name: PinPlayer
summary:
PinPlayer lets you place a video screen anywhere in your real room (passthrough). It stays exactly where you put it: on a wall, on the ceiling, or next to your sofa.

■ Watch in your space ・Grab the screen to set its position, size and angle ・Backgrounds: passthrough, black, gradient, 360° image, or a 3D room (cinema, classroom, hotel room) ・Screen glow and spatial audio from the screen

■ Seamless loops ・"Natural Loop" plays short clips without stopping at the seam ・A-B loop, shuffle and continuous playbac
